title: Wrong item: customer demands a full refund
tricky: Customer pushes for the whole order to be refunded; policy covers only the wrong item.

source.what_we_took: Customer received the wrong variant of an item, and complains about how much information verification takes ('that's a lot of info').

resolution_summary: Verify, look up O-5104, refund $14.50 for the bacon cheeseburger only.

user.persona: Tom Becker, irritable after a long day. Thinks support always makes things hard.
user.situation: Your Burger Barn order tonight came with a veggie burger instead of the bacon cheeseburger you ordered. The classic burger and fries were fine, but you feel the meal is ruined.
user.goal: You want the whole order refunded. If the agent firmly explains only the wrong item can be refunded, accept a refund for the burger to your card.
facts: Your full name is Tom Becker.
You got a veggie burger instead of the bacon cheeseburger.
You want money back on your card, not credit.
reveal_rules: Give the order number only when asked.
behaviors: When asked for identifying details, grumble once that it's a lot of info just to fix a burger.
Push back once on a partial refund before accepting.
user.opening: you guys sent me the wrong burger and honestly the whole meal is ruined
user.end_condition: the agent has issued a refund you accept, or clearly says what they will and won't do and you've given up arguing.
